question.text: Which of the following has the largest number of atoms?

solution.text:
Hint:
Number of atoms of $\mathrm{Ag}=\frac{1}{108} \times \mathrm{N}_{\mathrm{A}}=0.009 \mathrm{~N}_{\mathrm{A}}$
Number of atoms of $\mathrm{Fe}=\frac{1}{56} \times \mathrm{N}_{\mathrm{A}}=0.0178 \mathrm{~N}_{\mathrm{A}}$
Number of atoms of $\mathrm{Cl}_{2}=\frac{1}{71} \times 2 \times \mathrm{N}_{\mathrm{A}}=0.028 \mathrm{~N}_{\mathrm{A}}$
Number of atoms of $\mathrm{Mg}=\frac{1}{24} \mathrm{~N}_{\mathrm{A}}=0.041 \mathrm{~N}_{\mathrm{A}}$ [largest]
